items.what_happened: On 27 July 2026, wholesale prices surged at Ōtāhuhu and Haywards. Ōtāhuhu averaged $3,296.04/MWh and Haywards $2,853.43, while Benmore was $571.46. See /2026/07/27/.
items.why: North Island slow reserve cost $2,154.45/MWh while the South Island paid $0. The North Island may have been short of backup while power was still moving north.
items.what_it_means: The two islands paid very different wholesale prices in the same half-hour. The Ōtāhuhu–Benmore spread was $2,724.58/MWh.
